coordinate: Unitless distance along the continuous southern street frontage, west edge 0, east edge 1. Apply to the surveyed total run and local curved wall rather than uncorrected photo x.
convention: W5 and E5 are the outer western and eastern bays; Cw/Cc/Ce are three separate narrow openings over the through passage.

historic_montage.reason: The historic montage crops the extreme east margin. Both endpoints are transferred from the complete pre-conservation photo, in which the west/east wall boundaries lie at x=4/791.

after_construction_read: civic-3-0 and civic-3-4 are built photographs. Pic-14 is the previous facade. Pic-13 synthesizes historic photographs into a frontal montage. Pic-15 is a proposed design only. Citing all five distinguishes the apparent spacings, including the narrower-looking west end in pic-15.

ground_check.central_passage: No ground glazing in the Cw/Cc/Ce openings. The through passage and its sign are separate construction.

uncertainty: Near centre, normalized across-image jamb spreads can be checked below. Overall phase of the historic montage and the cropped eastern margin cause a wall-end/curve uncertainty of roughly 0.004–0.010 of full frontage. Oblique views constrain occluded bay widths collectively but cannot recover unseen shop fittings. A fully georeferenced site fit supersedes absolute translation and scale.
